"Yes, I can hear you. What's the matter?"
Sakura will talk about her plans for the weekend.
"Would you like to go to the park with us? There's a new exhibit."
"It's nice. What time do you go?"
"Yes, how about ten in the morning?"
"It's ten in the morning. It's fine. Let's meet at the gate of the park."
"Yes, it's ten in the morning. Is it close to the station?"
"This is it. Do you have anything?"
"Let's bring a water bottle. It's hot."
"Yes, then, at ten in the morning,"
"Oh, sorry. I'll call you later. Hey, I have to go shopping again."
Taro is looking forward to it very much.
The two went to the park together tomorrow morning.
Sakura and Taro had a nice day.
